snippet.title: The Real Reason Marvel Wanted Inde Navarrette
snippet.description:

Inde Navarrette became the breakout star of *Obsession*, one of the biggest surprise hits of the year. But despite the movie’s massive success, reports around her pay suggest she may have earned only around $20,000 for the role — a figure that has never been publicly confirmed by Navarrette herself.

snippet.title: The $100M Lie That Made Ryan Reynolds Rich
snippet.description:

In 2011, Green Lantern flopped so badly that Warner Bros. scrapped the sequel, and it almost ended Ryan Reynolds' career. Two years before that, he'd already lost Deadpool, when Fox put him in X-Men Origins: Wolverine and sewed his mouth shut. Today, the 3 Deadpool movies he ended up making have brought in $2.9 billion, and he's sold a gin brand, a phone company and an ad agency along the way.

In this video, I break down how losing Green Lantern turned out to be the best thing that happened to Ryan Reynolds' bank account.
